backlog.title: Bugfix wave 001_64331ded9ddb — re-ask confirmation loop, closed-edit invalidation, moot reasons, epoch-echo friction
backlog.description: Fix the five PRD-validated defects in pi-interrogator: the two re-ask wedges that silently block the FR-5 completion injection (PRD BUG-001 critical, BUG-002 major), the FR-18 confirm bypass on closed-question edits (BUG-003), the FR-17 moot reason never rendered in panel views (BUG-004), and the spurious STALE on an honest epoch echo after completion (BUG-005). Baseline: 46 files / 1265 tests + typecheck green; both gates must stay green. Research is complete and stored in plan/003_f8af1c6f6c49/bugfix/001_64331ded9ddb/architecture/ (system_context.md + four verified seam maps).

milestones.title: Re-ask confirmation loop end-to-end (PRD BUG-002 + BUG-001 — the release blockers)
milestones.description: Make a re-asked question re-confirmable and make every pending (answered) answer deliverable, so the re-ask → re-confirm → submit → close-pass → completion (FR-5) loop closes for BOTH re-ask flavors: rule-1 (same options, answer kept, status reasked) and rule-2 (options changed, answer deleted, user re-picks the same value). Order: fix submit()'s empty-diff early return first (D-R6 panel parity), then exclude `reasked` from the ANSWER-PIN-001 same-value no-ops, then prove the full round trip with an integration regression.

tasks.title: submit() ships pending answers despite an empty answer-signature diff (PRD BUG-002, D-R6 panel parity)
tasks.description: In src/panel/actions.ts submit(), the early return `if (diff.changed.length === 0 || userChanged.length === 0)` (line 595) fires even when pendingIds (status === "answered") is non-empty, because computeDiff is answer-signature-only and status-blind (snapshots.ts:229). After a rule-2 re-ask answered with the identical value the last snapshot already holds, ctrl+s flashes 'nothing to submit', never flushes answered→submitted, never bumps the epoch, never delivers — and maybeAutoSubmit's transition call into the same pipeline is equally dead. Fix per the PRD recommendation and decision D-R6 ('bridge submissions flush answered→submitted even when the diff is empty'): treat non-empty pendingIds as user shipments even when the diff is empty.

tasks.title: Rule-1 re-ask re-confirmation: same-value commits re-mark `reasked` → `answered` (PRD BUG-001)
tasks.description: The ANSWER-PIN-001 same-value no-ops in acceptOptionIndex (src/panel/actions.ts:293-297) and writeInEnter (:379-385) check answer presence with NO status exclusion. A rule-1 re-ask (lifecycle.ts:198 flips submitted→reasked KEEPING the answer) therefore leaves the question permanently reasked: same-value enter/digit/write-in is inert, the question counts as unanswered everywhere, ctrl+s reports 'nothing to submit', the close pass only archives submitted, and completion (whose BLOCKING set includes reasked — completion.ts) can never fire. Exclude `reasked` from both no-op guards so the existing fall-through re-commits the kept value (applyAnswer → evaluateDependsOn → advance → maybeAutoSubmit with wasUnanswered=true). Scope is TIGHT: closed and answered same-value no-ops stay inert.

milestones.title: Panel correctness: closed-edit FR-18 confirm (PRD BUG-003) and real FR-17 moot reasons (PRD BUG-004)
milestones.description: Two independent panel-view correctness fixes. BUG-003: the FR-18 ripple-confirm seam fires only when the EDITED question's status is answered/submitted; closed (archived) questions are editable per FR-2/AC-13 and carry recorded answers, so their edits bypass the user-worded Q39=B force-accept modal and silently moot answered dependents. BUG-004: no panel view renders the dependency-derived h2.29 reason (`moot: {dep}={value}`); short-view/overview/layout substitute the moot question's own answer text/value or 'dependency changed', and the UI tests are masked by fixtures that pre-bake the literal reason string.
